description.value:
Duration constant

Whichever ONE MORE grants you — extra reach, or a second simultaneous Strike — persists until the end of your next turn rather than vanishing when the action resolves. The second Strike is available once more during that time; the reach simply remains. Everything else about ONE MORE is unchanged, including that nobody who sees it can afterwards agree on what they saw extra of.

cinderfall.incomplete: Extends ONE MORE's duration -- ONE MORE itself is unbuildable (no generic extra-Strike/extra-reach rule element exists), so this extension has nothing to hook.
